description: Definition of the 39-class plant-derived-only subset used in this study, derived from the 47-class source dataset (Figshare DOI 10.6084/m9.figshare.31136233).

source_dataset.name: Image dataset of toxic Chinese herbal medicines

excluded_classes.reason: Excluded to restrict scope to plant-derived decoction pieces exclusively, avoiding confounding the texture-attention mechanism (LTA) with material-type effects unrelated to fine-grained visual discrimination among botanically similar specimens.

splits_used.note: The original release's supplementary 'test_subset' partition (476 images) was found to be a byte-identical (MD5-identical) duplicate of the validation split during data-quality checks and was therefore excluded from use as an independent evaluation set. All test-set metrics reported in the manuscript refer exclusively to the 636-image held-out test partition.

per_class_sample_range.note: Reflects the natural class imbalance of the source collection; no imposed sampling scheme was applied.
